say: Meet SpendGuard: an AI that checks every PayPal payment before it leaves your account.
Budgeting apps tell you that you overspent after the money is already gone. SpendGuard steps in before it goes.
It reads a month of payments from PayPal: sales, payouts, fees and refunds.
show: SpendGuard reads a month of payments from PayPal: sales, payouts, fees and refunds

say: Up top, one number to act on: what is safe to spend today, against your monthly budget.
show: One number to act on: what is safe to spend today, against your monthly budget

say: Alerts and AI notes catch what you would miss: a spending spike, forgotten subscriptions, and an unusual four hundred and forty nine dollar payment, made at 2 AM.
show: Alerts and AI notes: spending spikes, forgotten subscriptions, an unusual $449 payment at 2 AM

say: Every day of the month at a glance. Tap a day to see exactly what went out.
show: Every day of the month at a glance. Tap a day to see its payments

say: And here is where the money went, compared with the same days last month.
show: Where the money went, compared with the same days last month

say: Every transaction lives in an AG Grid table you can search, filter and sort.
show: Every transaction in an AG Grid table: search, filter, sort

say: The AI sorts each payment into a category. If it gets one wrong, tap it and fix it.
show: The AI sorts each payment into a category. Wrong? Tap it and fix it

say: Now the main feature. Let's buy a hundred and twenty dollars of running shoes, late at night.
show: Now the main feature: $120 of running shoes, late at night

say: SpendGuard checks the payment before anything reaches PayPal.
show: SpendGuard checks the payment before anything reaches PayPal

say: Stopped. My shopping budget is set to block, and this payment would push me over it.
show: STOPPED: the Shopping budget blocks payments, and this one would go over

say: I can wait and decide later, or override it, but only by writing down why.
show: Wait and decide later, or override, but only by writing down why

say: I'll wait. Impulse buys rarely survive the wait.
show: I'll wait. Impulse buys rarely survive the wait

say: Next, a classic scam: a six hundred and fifty dollar prize fee, to someone I have never paid.
show: A classic scam: a $650 "prize fee" to someone I have never paid

say: Hold. A large first-time payee and negative cash flow, flagged before a single dollar moves.
show: HOLD: large first-time payee and negative cash flow, flagged before a dollar moves

say: A normal payment to my designer is cleared,
show: A normal payment to my designer is cleared

say: and sent through PayPal's Payouts API. Here is the exact request.
show: and sent through the PayPal Payouts API. Here is the exact request

say: Every checked payment is kept, including the reason for any override.
show: Every checked payment is kept, including the reason for any override

say: I can also just ask my PayPal. The AI looks up exact numbers with tools, instead of guessing.
show: Ask your PayPal. The AI looks up exact numbers with tools instead of guessing

say: Each budget can alert me, or block payments that would go over.
show: Each budget can alert you, or block payments that would go over
